d.ko: She's here to help! Let Sakuya Izayoi from the Touhou Project comfort you after encountering some hardships in this beautiful visual novel that aims to heal your troubles away!
d.en: She's here to help! Let Sakuya Izayoi from the Touhou Project comfort you after encountering some hardships in this beautiful visual novel that aims to heal your troubles away!
d.zh: 她为您而来，伸出援手！让来自《东方Project》的十六夜咲夜，为您在这款旨在消弭困扰的、美丽的视觉小说中，为遭遇困境后的您带来慰藉！
